title: Termination measure
contract: Countdown over nonnegative integers reaches zero in exactly n steps; each loop step strictly decreases a natural measure.
scope: Starting n=0..5; examine up to six transitions; no unbounded theorem.
assumptions: Exact finite abstract model in scope; no inference to unbounded behavior, LLMLang correspondence or other semantic profiles.

obligations.claim: Trace begins at n, ends at zero, has n transitions, every transition decreases by one.
